## About me

I am an Assistant Professor in Animal Genetics
at the University of Bologna and a recipient of
a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)
Postdoctoral Global Fellowship (ABPhenomics).

My background is in bioinformatics and systems
biology, including computational methods for
molecular interaction networks and omics data
integration.

My research spans animal genetics and genomics,
from the genetic architecture of complex traits
and pig metabolomics and phenomics to population
genomics, biodiversity and molecular traceability.

I develop and apply computational and statistical
approaches to analyse genomic, metabolomic,
metagenomic and phenotypic data.

## Research interests

- Animal genomics and complex traits
- Pig metabolomics and phenomics
- Multi-omics integration
- Computational biology and machine learning
- Biodiversity and environmental genomics
